cells.reason: NOM-242-SSA1-2009 section 7.1.8 sets tin at 100 mg/kg for processed fishery products 'canned products only' (register scope 'canned fishery products only'), which covers canned tuna and canned fish; it is a wet-weight content ML on an as-consumed content cell, in force since 2011-05-10 (the 2012 modification did not touch 7.1.8). Every other non-gated food-content tin row that reaches canned fish is looser: CR RTCR 409 canned fishery products 200000, IN FSSAI canned fish products 200000, EU 2023/915 canned foods 200000, CL Decreto 977 canned fish/shellfish 250000, Codex CXS 193 / AU-NZ Sch 19 / HK Cap 132V / CN GB 2762-2025 / TH / SG / UY 250000; the 50000 rows are infant-food or non-tinplate cured-meat scopes, not this product.
